description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_BigInteger, which extends Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Integer. It implements a wrapper for handling 'big integer' values in the Zend XML-RPC library, incorporating functionality to initialize with a value and retrieve that value.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_BigInteger
classes.description: A class for representing big integer values in XML-RPC communications, extending the Integer value class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the big integer value using Zend_Crypt_Math_BigInteger.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the big integer value stored in this object.
